What we buy

We're picky,
in a good way.

We pay cash for what we can resell, and donate the rest. We don't have set rates, but we have a structure for how we assess it.

The three grades

Every item gets sorted on the spot.

We split clothing into three grades during our assessment — and we will let you know what is going where and why along the way.

Most Wanted
Valuable & resellable clothing
Paid individually
assessed piece by piece
Reserved for pieces with real resale value — brands people actually seek out, condition that holds up, styles that move. These are assessed one by one, not lumped together. Men's pieces are especially sought after right now.
What qualifies
Vintage Denim or brands such as Levi's, Wrangler, Lee. The baggier, the better. Surf & skate brands such as Billabong, Quiksilver, Volcom, Ripcurl Outdoor & workwear — Carhartt, Patagonia, Arc'teryx Designer labels in good condition Sportswear such as Rugby / Cricket / Football / Basketball jerseys Graphic Tees and/or Vintage with Character
Tip: flag any standout pieces when you book — we'll look out for them.
Also Welcome
General adult clothing
Paid per kg
whole collection, one price
Most item's fall here. Wearable adult clothing in mixed condition — no standout pieces, but clean and sellable. We weigh the lot and pay a flat rate per kilogram. Simple, fast, no haggling.
What qualifies
Everyday brands of adult men's and women's clothing Good condition, no major damage Mixed labels and styles Tops, bottoms, dresses, knitwear Coats and jackets without brand premium
A typical wardrobe clear-out — 3 bags of mixed adult clothing — usually lands here.
Donated
Worn, damaged, or low-value items
Donated free
to local charities · nothing to landfill
Anything we can't resell goes to local charities and op shops — including Dove Hospice, Pregnancy Choice, Red Cross, and the Salvation Army. We don't charge for this — it's part of the deal. Nothing gets thrown out.
What goes here
Children's and kids' clothing (all of it) Adult clothing with heavy wear or damage Fast Fashion or unbranded items we can't resell Clothing mixed into a premium or standard lot
You don't need to sort anything before we arrive — we handle the grading on the day.
What's outside our scope

Mostly clothing. A few exceptions.

We focus on adult clothing — that's where we can do our job properly. Bags, accessories, homewares, linen, toys, books, and electronics are outside our scope. Shoes are a maybe: mention a standout pair alongside a good clothing collection and we'll take a look.

Got a mix? That's fine — just bag your clothing separately and leave the rest. You don't need to sort clothing into grades; we do that. Just keep non-clothing items out of the bags.
On the day

How the assessment works.

01
We look through everything
We go through your bags there and then, pulling out anything that looks premium. This takes 5–15 minutes depending on the volume.
02
We make you an offer
Premium pieces get individual prices. The rest gets weighed. We give you a total and you decide — no pressure, no obligation to accept.
03
Paid before we leave
If you're happy, we pay via bank transfer on the spot. Everything we take goes with us — nothing gets left behind to sort later.

"We're a resale business — and we're upfront about that. Great clothing deserves a second life, not a landfill."
